name: 03264 · Plymouth, NH
findings: ZIP 03264 (Plymouth) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03264 (Plymouth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03264 (Plymouth) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
